jurisdiction: RMK Estonia public written timber auctions
schema_probe_exclusion: The 2026-06-30 offer and result files inspected for schema are permanently excluded from blind model evaluation; they may only inform field mapping and support gates.
scientific_question: At each comparable timber auction, can sequential local models improve the next-auction predictive density or point error for awarded EUR/m3 and allocated m3 within supported product-location strata?
outcomes: official awarded price EUR/m3 by sale object and delivery destination
official awarded volume m3 by sale object and delivery destination
causal_unit: one official auction predicts exactly the next comparable auction; no set of N auctions is condensed into one target
ordered_acquisition: inventory public auction dates without opening XLSX payloads
freeze URL list hashes product ontology transport normalization and support rules
open 2023 offer-result pairs in date order and update after each official result
continue 2024 then 2025 then 2026 without looking ahead
activate calendar-phase model only after at least two completed prior observations in the same phase and supported stratum

models.M0: local last-observation persistence after official transport normalization
models.M1: sequential Student-t or NIG local dynamic level by product and comparable location stratum
models.M2: M1 plus preregistered calendar-phase residual hierarchy; unavailable until phase support gate passes

normalization_gate.rule: Convert delivery-location bids to the RMK comparable intermediate-roadside price using only the transport tariffs and distance table published before the auction cutoff.

support_gates.unawarded_or_protested_objects: separate outcome states; never silently dropped

scoring: log score for predictive density where estimable
